name: mechpro-aws
description: AWS-native backend for MechPro: Convex-compat runtime, Lambda handlers, and CDK infrastructure.

scripts.db:up: docker run -d --name mechpro-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpw -e POSTGRES_DB=mechpro -p 55433:5432 postgres:16
scripts.db:schema: docker cp db/schema.sql mechpro-pg:/tmp/schema.sql && docker exec mechpro-pg psql -U postgres -d mechpro -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /tmp/schema.sql
scripts.cdk:synth: npm run build && cdk -a 'node --experimental-strip-types infra/bin/mechpro.ts' synth
scripts.cdk:deploy: npm run build && cdk -a 'node --experimental-strip-types infra/bin/mechpro.ts' deploy --require-approval never
